text: This is in Saigon, just at the end of Tudo street. The street with the flowers led to this street. There was also the Majestic Hotel and the Continental Hotel were by the My Canh. The Majestic is where The press stayed. The press were all a bunch of assholes, drunk and taking drugs. They would pay the Vietnamese for stories.
